full_judgment:
37. In spite of the presumption of truth attached to oral evidence under oath if the Court is not satisfied, the evidence in spite of oath is of no avail. 

 40. It is true that crime like rape to death is shocking in nature and also, revolting. The  Crime is against Society and humanity, but the prosecution convicted the accused merely on suspicion that the accused committed rape to death. There cannot be conviction on mere suspicion or presumption. The commission of rape to death must be proved. The presumption cannot take the place of positive evidence, (1970 Pak Crl.L.J. 166),
